authoritative_note: Use this resolved runtime taxonomy for storage axes and canonical feature keys in MVP. If earlier prose differs, use aliases below and store under the resolved axis.

storage_axes.ingredient: Canonical ingredient ids from ingredient_dictionary / ingredient_alias

storage_rules.questionnaire_answers_role: normalized projection for filtering and analytics; not authoritative
storage_rules.hard_constraints_storage: Store hard constraints only in user_constraints. Do not duplicate hard constraints into user_feature_values.
storage_rules.explicit_profile_layer: Use profile_layer='explicit' only for non-hard questionnaire-derived user features and dislikes/preferences.
storage_rules.event_layers: Use profile_layer='long_term' and 'short_term' only for event-derived profile updates and optional carry-over from explicit soft preferences.
storage_rules.modifier_policy: Modifiers patch consumed item features first. Infer soft preference only from repeated patterns across 3+ distinct events. Never infer hard status from a modifier alone.
storage_rules.dish_feature_priority: Deterministic rules > computed nutrition > manual > offline LLM candidates.
storage_rules.mvp_scope: Stage A deterministic dish features must be sufficient for an end-to-end MVP. Offline LLM menu tagging is optional behind a flag and must not block MVP delivery.
